definitions.explanation: A newspaper that covers news primarily for a specific region or prefecture, as opposed to national newspapers. Japan has many strong regional papers with loyal local readerships.

examples.japanese: {地方紙|ちほうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地方紙|ちほうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦{載|の}っていなかった→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: That news was only in the local newspaper.

examples.japanese: {地方紙|ちほうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げる→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{全国紙|ぜんこくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Regional newspapers cover detailed local news, so they contain information not found in national papers.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (region, locality) and {紙|し} (paper, short for ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧). Japan has a robust regional newspaper tradition, with papers like the {北海道新聞|ほっかいどうしんぶん}, {中日新聞|ちゅうにちしんぶん}, and {西日本新聞|にしにほんしんぶん} having very high readership in their regions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地方紙|ちほうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ — a regional newspaper article
- {地方紙|ちほうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧ — a local newspaper reporter
- {県紙|けんし} — prefectural newspaper (more specific)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全国紙|ぜんこくし} — national newspaper (antonym)
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧ — newspaper (general term)
- ⟦{夕刊|ゆうかん}→夕刊：18550_yuukan⟧ — evening paper
